title: Reusing Assurance Evidence in AI Pipelines: Validity Conditions, a Fail-Closed Release Gate, and a Replay of 714 Public Data Version Control Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2610.27672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rerunning every governance control after every change to an artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline is expensive, so teams reuse earlier results. Reuse is safe only if each control's declared dependencies cover everything that can change its outcome, and only if the release gate checks that reused evidence describes the candidate being released. This article makes both conditions explicit and measures how often the first fails in practice. It defines when a signed evidence record is valid for a candidate and gives sufficient conditions under which change-local re-execution reaches the same release decision as rerunning every control. A reference gate implementing these checks with Ed25519 digital signatures blocks eight of nine manipulation scenarios, against one for a gate that trusts the planner and three for a gate that only verifies signatures; a dependency the policy never declared passes every gate. translated_title: AI管道中保证证据的复用：有效性条件、故障关闭式发布门控，以及对714个公开数据版本控制管道的重放
translated_abstract: 在人工智能（AI）管道每次变更后重新运行所有治理控制代价高昂，因此团队会复用先前的结果。只有当每个控制所声明的依赖项涵盖了所有可能改变其结果的因素，并且发布门控检查复用的证据是否描述了正在发布的候选版本时，复用才是安全的。本文将这两个条件明确化，并测量了第一个条件在实践中的失效频率。文章定义了签名证据记录何时对某个候选版本有效，并给出了变更局部重新执行能够达到与重新运行所有控制相同发布决策的充分条件。一个使用Ed25519数字签名实现这些检查的参考门控阻止了九种操纵场景中的八种，相比之下，信任规划器的门控仅能阻止一种，仅验证签名的门控仅能阻止三种；而一个策略从未声明的依赖项则可以通过所有门控。对来自……的38,083次提交的重放（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文为AI管道中保证证据的复用建立了有效性条件，提出基于Ed25519签名的故障关闭式发布门控（可阻止9种操纵场景中的8种），并通过对714个公开数据版本控制管道的38,083次提交进行重放，量化了依赖声明在实践中失效的情况。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes validity conditions for reusing assurance evidence in AI pipelines, proposes a fail-closed release gate with Ed25519 signatures that blocks 8 of 9 manipulation scenarios, and replays 38,083 commits from 714 public data version control pipelines to quantify how often undeclared dependencies cause reuse failures in practice.
